title: Wire the robot · power disconnected
header_orientation_note: Header schematic lists physical pins; identify the actual pin 1 marking. Column layout is logical and does not assert photographic board orientation.
single_source: Owned MDY-14-ED → original cable → 5991 fixed 20 V → external 5 A fuse → 2 m XT30 tether → onboard DFR1202 → shared 5 V star

steps.title: Identify connectors with power disconnected
actions: Disconnect the charger, Pi and motors while making the harness.
Locate physical pin 1 from the actual Pi marking. Numbers shown here are header positions, not BCM GPIO numbers.
Label both ends of each lead and read actual connector polarity.
steps.check: Each physical cable matches its named endpoints; no stock shortage is assumed.

steps.title: Prepare the 20 V input
actions: Set only the 20 V switch on receiver 5991; keep ISET open.
Fit the external 5 A input fuse immediately after the positive terminal, before the 2 m tether.
Insulate and retain the receiver and cable joints.

steps.check: Source-side XT30 contacts are recessed female. Confirm markings with a meter; keep the source unplugged.

steps.title: Connect the converter and 5 V star
actions: Keep the 20 V input distinguishable from all 5 V loads.
Fit DFR1202 in the open insert with insulation, rear heat spreading and airflow.
Make separate insulated positive and ground star joins.

connections.wire: 18 AWG pair, ≤100 mm
16 AWG pair, ≤100 mm

steps.check: No direct 20 V connection reaches a Pi, motor or amplifier.

steps.title: Assign motor, Pi and audio branches
actions: F0 is the 10 A motor main; F1–F8 are eight 3 A motor branches. Split into two four-branch trunks within 100 mm of the converter.
F9 is the separate 3 A Pi branch; F10 is the 0.5 A audio branch.
Grounds are common and unfused. Carrier slot numbers do not determine electrical assignments.

Separate logic branch
Separate audio branch

steps.check: 11 onboard fuses fit the carrier; the 5 A input fuse stays outside the robot.

steps.title: Wire the eight motor groups
actions: Label fifteen X3P cables before modifying power conductors.
The receiving servo plug keeps pin 1 GND, pin 2 VDD and pin 3 DATA. Pins 1/2 join that servo’s assigned branch.
At the preceding outgoing plug remove and insulate pins 1/2, retain pin 3 DATA. OpenRB’s first plug uses the separately specified ground connection.
Locate the F7 split 20 mm and F8 split 30 mm toward the torso from the pair midpoint; keep at least 30 mm tail allowance and 40 mm on the long branch before trimming.

actions: At the first OpenRB outgoing plug remove VDD pin 2; retain DATA pin 3 and connect pin 1 separately to the ground star.
Leave OpenRB VIN, XT60 pads and its other three motor ports unused.

steps.title: Fit Pi power and OpenRB USB
actions: Use physical pins 2/4 for 5 V and 6/14 for ground.
All twelve power, IMU and audio contacts share the retained 40-position housing.
Keep Pi PWR IN empty and covered; set OpenRB jumper to USB/VIN 5 V while disconnected.

actions: Open both latches with power disconnected.
Fit the 15-contact end to Camera Module 3 Wide and 22-contact end to Pi Zero.

steps.title: Connect audio and speaker
actions: Power the amplifier through F10.
Fit 100 kΩ from GAIN to VIN for 3 dB gain; retain amplifier and speaker with narrow ties.
Connect both speaker outputs only to speaker pads; insulate solder joints and strain-relieve.

steps.title: Complete the unpowered inspection
actions: With electronics and source unplugged, check continuity, polarity, insulation and unintended positive-to-ground paths.
Remove each fuse and confirm its positive branch is isolated.
Confirm motor VDD is isolated from OpenRB VDD and USB VBUS.
Move joints with torque off to check slack, rubbing and strain relief; preserve service allowance.

current_compute_note: Mac runs control and policy; Pi acquires and forwards sensors. The retained Pi USB/OpenRB bridge is the physical transport; bus ownership, software migration and timing need separate commissioning.
stock_note: All prints, user-owned OMX parts and all 15 DigiKey lines are received per user reports. This guide requests no purchases or printing.
fuse_stage_note: Mechanical modules can precede harness fabrication. Current wiring includes an external 5 A input fuse and 11 onboard fuses; the OpenRB USB fuse protects another path.
physical_unknowns: Which loose cable in userstock corresponds toX3P/SC1892/4397/4472/SC0727
